name: Obsidian GT Coupé
description: A bespoke Ferrari finished in obsidian black with vivid orange brake calipers. Single owner, full service history, ceramic-coated.
narrative: Acquired from a private collector in Monaco, this 488 has lived its life on coastal roads — never tracked, always pampered. The Nero leather cabin still smells new.

name: Phantom Slate SUV
description: Flagship X7 with executive package, sky lounge panoramic roof, and Bowers & Wilkins diamond audio.
narrative: Specified in Munich for a UAE delivery, this X7 represents the pinnacle of long-haul luxury. Every option box ticked.

name: Wraith Silver Spectre
description: Suicide doors, starlight headliner with 1,340 fibre optics, and a hand-finished waterfall console.
narrative: A rare commissioned Wraith, finished in Silver Mist over Seashell hide. Owned by a private collector and stored in a climate-controlled facility.

name: Crimson Apex
description: LDVI-equipped EVO with sport exhaust, lift system, and forged carbon interior package.
narrative: Ordered new from Sant'Agata Bolognese with Ad Personam touches throughout — every line of this Huracán is intentional.

name: Arctic Roadster
description: Iconic Targa silhouette with PASM sport suspension, Sport Chrono package, and 21" Carrera S wheels.
narrative: Delivered to a private aviation collector, this Targa has been used sparingly on weekend coastal drives.

name: Midnight G-Wagon
description: AMG Night Package II, Carbon Trim Pack, AMG Performance Steering Wheel, and rear entertainment.
narrative: A factory-fresh G63 specified in the rare Cavansite Blue. The original window sticker and accessories remain sealed.

name: Champagne Ghost
description: Extended wheelbase Ghost with Planar Suspension, Whisper Acoustics, Bespoke Audio, and rear theatre configuration.
narrative: Commissioned from Goodwood with a one-of-one champagne paint. Every detail tailored over a 14-month build.

name: Inferno Vantage
description: F1 aero kit, vented bonnet, lightweight alloys, and full carbon roof. Track-tuned chassis with sports exhaust.
narrative: Sourced directly from a UK collector, this Vantage F1 Edition is among only a handful in the region.
